_method: Three fresh Node processes, 512 MiB old-space cap, real streaming graph sink, live synthetic inputs and explicit GC at each checkpoint. --check compares every count/hash and each first-emission heap delta. Timing and total heap/RSS checkpoints are diagnostic references, not portable speed budgets.
_budget: Allow 16 MiB of additional heap before the first emitted edge, versus approximately -1 MiB after this optimization and 86.7 MiB with the global collector. This budget has substantial runtime headroom while rejecting the previous allocation pattern. A signed delta includes GC/runtime bookkeeping; it is not an exact collector size.
_triage: Investigate changed hashes or heap growth before changing this reviewed baseline. CI never records or updates baselines.
